name: Zhejiang Shaoxing RuiFeng Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Shaoxing RuiFeng Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd is a commercial bank operating in China, offering a comprehensive suite of financial products and services. For individual clients, the bank provides diverse wealth management options, including various financial instruments, investments in precious metals and funds, insurance policies, and asset management solutions. Its deposit offerings encompass a range of account types such as savings, demand, time, structured, and notice deposits, in addition to certificates of deposit. The loan portfolio caters to diverse needs, featuring personal, business, consumer, mortgage, operating capital, and quick "e-flash" loans. Customers can also access a variety of payment cards, including standard credit and debit cards, premium gold and platinum cards, and exclusive VIP privilege cards. Additionally, the bank facilitates convenient digital banking through its mobile and online platforms. Beyond individual services, the bank extends its offerings to corporate clients through financial management solutions and comprehensive settlement services. These include payment collection and commitment, interbank transfers, electronic exchanges, bank drafts, local entrusted collections, transfer checks, and promissory notes. Furthermore, it provides an extensive array of international business and foreign exchange services. These encompass cross-border RMB transactions, various import and export financing options (such as documentary collections, letters of credit, factoring, and forfaiting), foreign exchange loans and deposits, guarantees, remittances, and spot foreign exchange settlement and sale. The bank maintains a substantial presence with a network of 26 branches and 79 branch offices, totaling 105 operational outlets. Established in 1987, its headquarters are situated in Shaoxing, China.
